name: Fall or Love
source:
A short VN about a simple love story between the hunter and the templar.

You are Kregan the hunter, and during what should be an easy mission, your team ended trapped in a cave, you are with Hugo - Templar, Nessa - Mage, Edmar - Defender, Meere - Assassin, Reith - Cleric, will your team be able to leave? More important than it, will you be able to love or will you just fall?

[From [url=https://kreig.itch.io/fall-or-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个简短的VN，讲述猎人和圣堂武士之间的简单爱情故事。

你是猎人克雷根，在本该是一个简单的任务中，你的团队被困在一个山洞里，你和雨果-圣堂武士、奈莎-法师、埃德玛-后卫、米尔-刺客、瑞斯-牧师，你的团队能离开吗？更重要的是，你能够去爱还是会坠落？

[来自[url=https://kreig.itch.io/fall-or-love]Itch.io[/url]]
